div.head: I Ew 3
div.ab: Eac we cwædon be ðam mannum ðe mansworan wæron, gif þæt geswytelod wære, oððe him að burste oððe ofercyðed wære, þæt hy syððan aðwyrðe næron, ac ordales wyrðe.
Eac we cwædon be þam mannum ðe mánsworan wæran, gif ðæt geswutelod wære, oððe him að burste oððe ofercyðed wære, þæt hy siððan aðwyrðe næran, ac ordales wyrðe.
Item diximus de illis hominibus, qui periuri fuerint, si manifestum sit, uel eis iuramentum fregerit, uel ouercyðed fuerint, ut deinceps non sint digni iuramento sed ordalio.
[Be mansworenum.] [Ld] Eac we cwædon be þam mannum ðe mánsworan wæran, gif ðæt geswutelod wære, oððe him að burste oððe ofercyðed wære, þæt hy siððan aðwyrðe næran, ac ordales wyrðe.

We have further declared, with regard to men who have been accused of perjury: if the charge has been proved, or if the oath on their behalf has collapsed, or has been overborne by more strongly supported testimony, never again shall they have the privilege of clearing themselves by oaths but only by the ordeal.

(Von meineidig Gewordenen. Ld) Ferner bestimmten wir über die Männer, welche meineidig sind, wenn dies erwiesen ist, oder ihnen ein Eid fehlschlägt oder überschworen wird, dass sie hinfort nicht [mehr] eideswürdig seien, sondern [nur] Ordales theilhaftig.

(Of those who have become perjurers. Ld) Further we determined concerning the men who are perjurers, if this is proved, or an oath fails them or is overborne by oath, that they should henceforth not [any longer] be worthy of an oath, but [only] of the ordeal.
